title: Zesty Smoky Spanish Sausages Patatas Bravas
description: A hearty, adventurous Spanish-inspired dish featuring Italian fennel sausages and lamination-puff patatas bravas, served in a crispy lotus leaf wrap. This keto-friendly recipe combines the flavors of the Basque region with the bold taste of fennel sausages and smoked paprika.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a large rectangle.
Cut out four rectangles from the pastry, each about 6 inches square.
Place a sheet of lotus leaves on a flat surface and place a pastry rectangle in the center of each lotus leaf.
Cut the Italian Fennel Sausages in half lengthwise and place 2 halves on each pastry rectangle, leaving a small border around the edges.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked paprika, garlic, olive oil, tomato paste, and red pepper flakes.
Brush the mixture evenly over the sausages and pastry, leaving a small border around the edges.
Fold the lotus leaves over the pastry, pressing the edges to seal and creating a crispy pastry package.
Place the packages on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with heavy cream (if using).
Bake for 20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and puffed up.
While the pastry is baking, heat the tomato sauce in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the pastry is done, remove it from the oven and carefully place it in a cheese pull position.
Pour the tomato sauce over the top of the pastry, followed by the shredded Manchego cheese.
Place the dish under the broiler for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the dish from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, salt, and black pepper to taste.
